title: (2025 MAY) Cumulative Updates for Business Central
summary: Cumulative updates for Business Central replace previously released updates across multiple versions. The post lists available updates for v26 (2025 Wave 1), v25 (2024 Wave 2), and v24 (2024 Wave 1), along with older unsupported versions, and notes that the latest updates should always be installed to address security vulnerabilities.
key_points: Cumulative updates replace previously released updates for each Business Central version
Latest updates should always be installed as some fix security vulnerabilities
Updates include hotfixes for all countries plus country-specific local versions
v26, v25, and v24 are actively updated; v23 and earlier versions are no longer updated
Both cloud and on-premises deployment options have update tracks

quotes.text: Some updates additionally fix vulnerabilities, so the latest update should always be installed.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that installing the latest cumulative update is essential for maintaining security posture

quotes.text: These updates replace previously released updates for each version of Business Central.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains that cumulative updates supersede earlier updates, so only the latest needs to be applied
